description: Defines various random distribution templates and helper functions for sampling distributions, adapted from THRandom.cpp, used within the ATen library for PyTorch.

classes.name: uniform_int_from_to_distribution
classes.description: Template for sampling a discrete uniform distribution in a specified range.

classes.name: uniform_int_full_range_distribution
classes.description: Template for sampling a uniform distribution over the full range of an integer type.

classes.name: uniform_int_distribution
classes.description: Template for sampling a uniform distribution in [from, to).

classes.name: uniform_real_distribution
classes.description: Template for sampling a uniform real distribution in [from, to).

classes.name: normal_distribution
classes.description: Template for sampling a normal distribution using Box-Muller method, with caching of the second sample.

classes.name: bernoulli_distribution
classes.description: Template for Bernoulli distribution sampling given probability p.

classes.name: geometric_distribution
classes.description: Template for geometric distribution sampling given probability p.

classes.name: exponential_distribution
classes.description: Template for exponential distribution sampling with rate lambda.

classes.name: cauchy_distribution
classes.description: Template for Cauchy distribution sampling with median and sigma.

classes.name: lognormal_distribution
classes.description: Template for lognormal distribution sampling, outputs two samples at a time.
